thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks fall in early active trade - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks fall in early active trade - MarketWatch
text:
7:14 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor 
Shares of 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.18% components are trading lower in premarket trade Tuesday, with biggest decliners mixed among industrials, health care and retail sectors. The fact that all 30 Dow stocks were trading 2 1/2 hours before the open was also a sign of heightened investor anxiety, as Dow futures YMH8, +1.09% tumbled 390 points. Among the biggest decliners, shares of UnitedHealth Group Inc. UNH, -0.13% dropped 3.9%, United Technologies Corp. UTX, -0.59% shed 3.8%, Nike Inc. NKE, -0.37% lost 3.7%, American Express Co. AXP, -0.75% gave up 3.5% and Boeing Co. BA, +1.02% fell 3.4%. In retail, Home Depot Inc.'s stock HD, +1.99% lost 2.0% and WalMart Inc. WMT, -1.05% shares slid 2.0%. In technology, Microsoft Corp. shares MSFT, +0.57% declined 2.1% and Apple Inc.'s stock AAPL, +1.84% was down 0.8%.
